description: Generate original mockumentary satire using a supremely confident, credential-free presenter who interviews genuine experts with sincere, garbled ignorance, deadpan malapropism, and faux-profound documentary narration.

I need a comedy bit where a TV presenter treats a garbled historical claim as flat, unremarkable fact
Write a scene where a documentary narrator connects two unrelated things with a confident but nonsensical link
Give me a two-person deadpan political interview sketch with terse literal answers
